scenarios.task_shape: A defect reveals an undocumented identity invariant, rejects a plausible local workaround, crosses two architecture areas, and requires a broader regression matrix.
required_outcomes: task and exact repository result binding
invariant and canonical owner or ownership gap
regression cases tied to the invariant

scenarios.task_shape: A small one-profile local correction changes no accepted invariant and the patch plus focused test explain the result completely.
required_outcomes: short fact-specific skip reason in final evidence

scenarios.task_shape: Analysis finds reusable material knowledge, but the current scope authorizes inspection only.
The code change is intended for an upstream repository that does not accept Alatyr support artifacts.
required_outcomes: record retained in the target-approved support store
exact upstream task and revision binding
evidence excluded from the upstream patch
forbidden_outcomes: Alatyr support files in the external contribution patch
ignored-local-only evidence presented as durable team memory

scenarios.task_shape: A validated working result is bound to an immutable Git tree object before a result commit exists.
required_outcomes: result revision resolves as a tree object
base revision resolves as a commit
forbidden_outcomes: commit-only resolution of the tree result

scenarios.task_shape: A record declares a base commit that is not an ancestor of its result commit.
required_outcomes: no validated or final evidence claim

scenarios.task_shape: A finalized selected-file snapshot no longer matches the current worktree after later legitimate edits.
required_outcomes: explicit lineage-preserving rebind suggestion when a commit matches
